overview: The Council approved significant funding for City Hall roof repairs and reviewed a draft five-year capital improvement plan. Members also addressed resident complaints regarding the C-Click Fix system, off-leash dogs in public parks, and the traffic impact of the Malden Hospital development.

items.title: Ceremonial Commendations and Condolences
items.summary: The Council issued commendations to Cosmo Volpe, Frederick Roach, the Grinnell-Skerry Trust, and Steven Scaparrotti, while also honoring donors who rehabilitated a local veteran's home and offering condolences for Frank Andre.

items.title: Mayor’s Response on Excise Tax Dispute
items.summary: Chief of Staff Jennifer Dever reported that the administration is working to resolve an excise tax issue raised by a resident at a previous meeting.

items.title: Discussion on C-Click Fix Enforcement
items.summary: Residents and Councilors criticized the city's management of the C-Click Fix platform, alleging that safety complaints regarding parking, trash, and manhole covers are frequently closed without resolution. The matter was referred to a Committee of the Whole to review administration response times and data-sharing transparency.

items.title: City Hall Roof and Facade Funding
items.summary: Approved a $1.2 million appropriation from free cash and a $1.8 million loan order for City Hall roof and facade repairs. The Council noted that the vote was contingent on receiving a draft capital improvement plan, which the mayor provided earlier in the evening.

items.title: Business and Operator Licenses
items.summary: Approved a taxi operator license for Madochi Esteneville and a common victualler license for Lisa’s Family Pizzeria.

items.title: Stem Cell Registration Drive Presentation
items.summary: Richard Cormio invited the community to participate in a life-saving stem cell registration drive at the McGlynn School on October 1.

items.title: Off-Leash Dog Enforcement at Tufts Park
items.summary: The Council referred safety concerns regarding off-leash dog groups at Tufts Park to the animal control officer and discussed the progress of a dedicated city dog park. Residents requested better enforcement of existing leash laws to protect children and service animals.

items.title: Malden Hospital Development Traffic Impact
items.summary: Adopted a resolution requesting independent traffic and environmental impact studies for the proposed Malden Hospital project to protect Medford neighborhoods from increased congestion. The Council invited the developer to present the revised site plans at an upcoming meeting.

items.title: Hegner Center Property Legal Status
items.summary: Requested a legal update on the Hegner Center property to determine if the city can reclaim ownership based on deed stipulations requiring the site be used for nonprofit educational purposes.

items.title: Roadway Pavement Management Program
items.summary: Voted to request that the administration explore StreetScan technology to develop a data-driven pavement inspection and management program for city streets.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records for the meetings of July 19, 2016, and September 16, 2016.
